records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended September 30, 2023, revenue was approximately $384.8 million, an increase of $196.6 million or 104% from $188.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The total increase in revenue was largely driven by continued gains in distribution points and Club Channel growth.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: This growth was the result of increased revenues from North America, where third quarter 2023 revenues were $371.2 million, an increase of $191.6 million or 107% from the same period in 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarter ended September 30, 2023, Selling, General and Administrative (SG&A) expenses totaled $96.4 million, down 57% or $129.8 million from $226.2 million in the same quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash flows provided by operating activities totaled approximately $136.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2023, which compares to $171.0 million cash provided by operating activities for the nine months ended September 30, 2022.
